description:
This beautifully presented 1-bedroom basement flat is available on the ever-popular Cheltenham Road. 

This one-bedroom basement flat offers bright, modern living in a great location.

The property features an open-plan kitchen and living area with contemporary units and white goods included. The double bedroom is a good size with plenty of natural light, and the bathroom is finished in a clean, modern style. The flat also offers an additional bright and convenient office or storage space. 

Don't miss your chance to view this stunning flat in one of Bristol's most sought-after areas.

- Location 

Located on vibrant Cheltenham Road, the flat is surrounded by a mix of independent shops, cafés, bars, and restaurants, with easy access to the city centre, Gloucester Road, and Stokes Croft. Excellent public transport links and nearby green spaces make it a popular area for professionals and creatives alike.

- Hopewell

Did you know we release our properties on social media before they hit the open market? Follow us on Facebook or Instagram to beat the crowd.

Council Tax Band: B (Bristol City Council)
Holding Deposit: £311.53
